name: Test Interface In Browser
summary: Exercise a bounded browser journey with state, network, console, accessibility, and visual evidence.
description: Test a web interface in a real browser across functional states, viewport behavior, console and network failures, accessibility, and persistence. Use when static review or unit tests cannot prove an important user journey.
risk_reason: This skill exercises a bounded browser journey with state, network, console, accessibility, and visual evidence; it does not bypass authentication, bot protection, access controls, or consent.
refuses: It does not bypass authentication, bot protection, access controls, or consent.
It does not claim cross-browser or assistive-technology coverage that was not run.
It does not alter production data or conceal console, network, or cleanup failures.

operational.latency_reason: The skill exercises a bounded browser journey with state, network, console, accessibility, and visual evidence, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
